recentItems.title: శ్రీవారి ఖజానాలోకి 121 కిలోల బంగారం.. తిరుమల చరిత్రలోనే అతిపెద్ద కానుక || Idisangathi
recentItems.description:
Tirumala, the sacred abode of Lord Venkateswara, is renowned not only for its spiritual significance but also for its extraordinary wealth and priceless collection of jewellery. In a historic offering, Chennai-based industrialist Vardhaman Jain and his wife Radhika Jain donated 121 kilograms of gold jewellery, valued at ₹207.6 crore, to Lord Venkateswara in the presence of Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu. The donation includes 46 ornaments featuring gold necklaces, a crown, anklets, waist ornaments and jewellery studded with diamonds and precious stones. Of the total gold, 106 kg was used for ornaments for Lord Venkateswara, while 15 kg was allocated for a gold garment for Goddess Padmavathi Ammavaru. This remarkable offering has renewed interest in the history of donations made to the Tirumala temple. From ancient kings like Sri Krishnadevaraya to devotees of the present day, discover the valuable ornaments and historic contributions that have enriched the temple's treasure over the centuries. What are the most remarkable jewels in the collection of Lord Venkateswara? Watch this special report for more details.

Union Home Minister Amit Shah launched a sharp attack on Congress leader Rahul Gandhi during the Samvidhan Gaurav Diwas event held in New Delhi. Shah accused Rahul Gandhi of using the Constitution for political purposes and alleged that he was ridiculing constitutional institutions and the electoral process. He criticised Rahul's remarks on holding discussions outside Parliament and accused him of undermining the credibility of the Election Commission by questioning the SIR exercise and the overall electoral process.

Amit Shah also reiterated the BJP's commitment to providing 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies. He further stated that the Uniform Civil Code would be implemented in BJP-governed states. His remarks have brought the political debate over constitutional institutions, electoral reforms and women's reservation into focus.

recentItems.title: బీజేపీకి యూపీ ప్రజలు గుణపాఠం చెప్పారు | మల్లికార్జున ఖర్గే విమర్శలు
recentItems.description:
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge launched a sharp attack on the BJP and Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the Samvidhan Raksha Sammelan held at the Congress office in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Referring to the 2024 Lok Sabha election results, Kharge said the people of Uttar Pradesh had taught the BJP a lesson, pointing out that the party failed to achieve its ambitious 'Ab Ki Baar, 400 Paar' target. He also questioned the political equation between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

Kharge accused the BJP of benefiting from rising prices and unemployment while ordinary and middle-class families face financial pressure. He questioned the source of the ₹10,000 crore reportedly held in the BJP's party account and alleged that central investigative agencies such as the IT Department, CBI and ED were being misused to intimidate people and collect money. Responding to Congress MP Imran Masood's remarks on seat-sharing with the Samajwadi Party for the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Kharge called on party leaders to focus more on work than statements.
